posts.description: Last updated: November 21, 2026. My Friends, Fredrik Backman I don’t read enough fiction . That was my first thought when I finished this book. posts.title: Reading List: September 2026
posts.description: The Guns of August , Barbara Tuchman Fantastic read about the opening months of World War I and how an assassination started a global chain reaction. Tuchman reveals how inflexible alliances dragged their members into war, and how individuals, hellbent on empire-building, rushed into battle, plunging their nations into war and killing millions of people. Full review here . Rejection, Tony Tulathim
